intended_object: The underlying quiver of a bundled reflexive quiver, i.e. the object part of the forgetful functor ReflQuiv → Quiv, which forgets the chosen identity arrows (from the docstring).
explanation: `↧C.α` is `Quiv.of C.α`. The `Quiver` instance it uses is the parent `Quiver` structure of the `ReflQuiver` instance `C.str`, because `ReflQuiver` extends `Quiver`. So the result has the same vertices and arrows as C, and only the identity arrows are dropped. That is exactly the underlying quiver. The universe levels (v, u) are kept, which is correct. The definition is fully general, and Mathlib has no other definition of this object.
